tools.name: get_stock_analysis
tools.description: The 0-100 composite for a symbol with its technical, fundamental and news pillars, the per-timeframe technical scores, every sub-score, and the current quote. Computed live and cached for two hours — the same numbers the analysis page draws.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Filter last night’s scores across every scoreable US-listed company by score band, sector, or a list of tickers to compare side by side. Returns compact rows, highest score first, each with how many points the composite moved in about a week. The feed excludes symbols whose fundamental score is miss

tools.name: top_scores
tools.description: The best-scoring symbols in the universe right now, highest first. Ranks only investable names — excludes symbols under $5, under $1B market cap, or with a risk grade above 7. Use screen_stocks to search without that ranking cut.

tools.name: get_score_history
tools.description: One symbol’s nightly scores for up to a year: the composite, each pillar, and the price the batch saw, plus how many points the composite moved in 7 and 30 days. Past days are re-blended on today’s pillar weights so the line is comparable across reweights.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_analysis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
